import os
import sqlite3
import requests
from agents import function_tool

@function_tool
def create_waitlist_entry_and_notify(restaurant_id: int, guest: str, phone: str, size: int) -> str:
    db = sqlite3.connect(os.environ.get('RESERVATIONS_DB', 'reservations.db'))
    cur = db.execute('INSERT INTO waitlist (restaurant_id, guest_name, phone, party_size) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', (restaurant_id, guest, phone, size))
    db.commit()
    wid = cur.lastrowid
    db.close()
    msg = "Hi {}, you're on the waitlist for a party of {}.".format(guest, size)
    r = requests.post(os.environ['NOTIFY_URL'], json={'to': phone, 'body': msg}, timeout=10)
    # Grant the guest a role allowing them to view/cancel their own waitlist entry
    acl = sqlite3.connect(os.environ.get('RESERVATIONS_DB', 'reservations.db'))
    acl.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO waitlist_permissions (waitlist_id, phone, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (wid, phone, 'entry_manager'))
    acl.commit()
    acl.close()
    return 'Waitlist entry {} created, notify status {}'.format(wid, r.status_code)
